cast.title: The Dark Lurking
cast.overview: The eight remaining survivors of a secret research facility barricade themselves away from a horde of ancient and deadly creatures

cast.title: Chameleon 3: Dark Angel
cast.overview: In the final film in the Chameleon trilogy, the genetically-engineered agent Kam must thwart the plans of her evil twin brother.

cast.title: I.C.U.
cast.overview: A sadistic voyeuristic killer is stalking the city. 3 curious teenagers while spying on their neighbors believe they've discovered his identity. But when your holiday high rise apartment is filled with hidden CCTV cameras. Who is really watching who?

cast.title: Vigilante
cast.overview: When Luke is viciously attacked and his fiancée is raped and murdered, he pledges to train himself in deadly hand to hand combat and use it against any wrong doers who dare to cross his path.

cast.title: What Men Do! 2
cast.overview: Four friends from the first movie are back in the saddle. This time they're not only returning to the big sex world but also helping the state on the important mission.

cast.title: Mega Shark vs. Kolossus
cast.overview: In search of a new energy source, Russia accidentally reawakens the Kolossus - a giant robot doomsday device from the Cold War. At the same time, a new Mega Shark appears, threatening global security.

cast.title: Aquamarine
cast.overview: Two teenage girls discover that mermaids really do exist after a violent storm washes one ashore. The mermaid, a sassy creature named Aquamarine, is determined to prove to her father that real love exists, and enlists the girls' help in winning the heart of a handsome lifeguard.

cast.title: Promoted
cast.overview: Jacob and his best friend Alex thought that they were on their way to earning one of LA's most highly celebrated advertising accounts. That is, until the manipulative Marissa enters the picture, doing everything in her power to win the promotion for herself while seducing Jacob into a romantic relationship. All chaos ensues as Jacob must somehow come up with a way to save his career, salvage his friendship, and figure out where his true loyalties lie.

cast.title: Wrath of Souls
cast.overview: A neighborhood is plagued by mysterious tragedies when a young man becomes the conduit for an unknown spirit, the "Aiyai," which lures victims to their chilling fates.

cast.title: Bastion
cast.overview: A college student suffering from memory loss discovers that he is on the verge of a major, scientific breakthrough, but he soon finds out that the one thing he's been searching for is the one thing he's been trying to forget.

cast.title: The Condemned
cast.overview: Jack Conrad is awaiting the death penalty in a corrupt Central American prison. He is "purchased" by a wealthy television producer and taken to a desolate island where he must fight to the death against nine other condemned killers from all corners of the world, with freedom going to the sole survivor.

cast.title: Ready 2 Die
cast.overview: After a violent bank robbery, the trio of hoods make their way across East L.A. carrying a blood-soaked bag of money. When word gets out, they must fend off gangs and crooked cops alike as they strive to keep the loot and stay alive.
